about: Every gk- class in css/gridkit.css and css/themes.css, in the block the demo shows it as. A class carries the release that first shipped it (read out of the git history once, in 1.93.0; the classes that first reached git with the rescue of live 1.27.2 carry the changelog entry that brought them, where it names one); a block's "since" is its oldest class. "changed" is the last release that changed a block without adding a class to it, kept by hand from 1.92.0 on; a new class marks its block as changed by itself. tests/blocks.test.php fails on a class that is in a stylesheet and not here, and on one that is here and in no stylesheet.
